title: Firework profile
description: A straight-line op program plus its default attributes: data/<namespace>/fireworks/<name>.json. Ranges mirror Attributes and FireworkLimits; values outside them are clamped by the runtime, so the schema flags them instead. An unknown op is a hard error; an unknown attribute is kept and ignored.

attributes.description: The open attribute bag. Known keys are typed below; unknown keys are allowed on purpose so newer content still loads on an older build.

flight.speed.description: Blocks per tick. Overrides the launch op's speed when present.

flight.ticks.description: Flight time in ticks, edited with string in the crafting table. A `wait` with no `ticks` spends exactly this, so it is how long the rocket rises before the next op.

flight.direction.yaw.description: Horizontal dial in degrees, relative to whoever launches the rocket: 0 is straight ahead, growing toward their right.

flight.direction.pitch.description: Vertical dial in degrees: the polar angle from world up, so 0 is straight up.

flicker.description: Make every burst of this rocket flicker like a vanilla firework star with Flicker set: the sparks blink back instead of fading once.

decorative.description: Immune to damage and ignored by entity targeting.

afterglow.description: Ticks the entity survives after its program ends.

trail.interval.description: Emit a trail particle every N ticks.

trail.colors.description: Trail colours; one is chosen at random per particle.

launch.sound.description: Sound played once when the rocket is created.

sound.id.description: Overrides the id of every sound op.

light.ticks.description: Overrides the ticks of every light op.

show.description: The show a burst bakes: an installed id, or an inline show document.

show.color.description: Recolours every point of this burst. Absent means the show's own palette decides; together with show.size and show.yaw/pitch this is how one primitive show serves every node of a figure.

show.size.description: Scales this burst's geometry and particle size around the burst origin.

show.yaw.description: Rotates this burst's geometry around Y, in degrees.

show.pitch.description: Rotates this burst's geometry around X, in degrees.

op.description: One timed instruction. `at` places it on the frame's tick timeline, `when` gates it on physics, nesting is call/end, children are spawn.

speed.description: launch only: initial speed in blocks per tick. An attribute override wins.

ticks.description: light only: light duration (0..400). wait only: a literal number of ticks (1..400); omit it to spend the rocket's flight time instead.

profile.description: call/spawn only: the firework profile whose program runs (call) or whose attributes and program the child rocket gets (spawn). A spawn op names either this or `children`, never both.

children.description: spawn only: child slots of the launching item's nested tree, one rocket per entry. Slot n is the n-th entry of the item's child list, and the tooltip lists the same numbering. A slot the item does not fill spawns nothing. Cannot be combined with `profile` or `count`.

count.description: spawn only: how many copies of `profile` to create. Not allowed with `children`; repeat the slot in that list instead.

delay.description: spawn only: ticks before each child appears.
